target_customer: Adult consumers on iPhone who want interactive AI fiction and character chat
problem: Existing AI story tools forget context or lean on heavy filters; Swerve offers stories that unfold around what the user says and does, later adding AI video with friends.
business_model: Consumer freemium subscription and in-app purchases (Pro listed at 12.49 USD, Lite at 3.99 USD by secondary sources)

founders.name: Soroush Saryazdi
education: Concordia University, M.S. in computer science
founders.background_notes: YC page says he led AI at Matic (home robot perception) and co-authored Gradslam.

founders.name: Jason Zhou
education: UC Berkeley, B.S. and M.S. in EECS
founders.background_notes: YC page says he led autonomy and simulation at Matic and was a Siebel Scholar.

competitors.name: AI Dungeon
competitors.traction_then: established, many alternatives lists name it

competitors.name: NovelAI
competitors.what: Long-form AI story writing with minimal moderation

technical_complexity.rationale: Built on third-party language models plus an iOS app and later video generation; the hard parts are memory and story consistency, not new research.

defensibility.rationale: Character chat and AI fiction apps are widely copyable and users switch between them freely; secondary sources report a large library of community characters but no lock-in.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquisition or copying event reported in the sources found.

market_need_then: AI companion and story apps had strong engagement in 2025 per one review headline, though the same piece flagged market limits; AI Dungeon alternatives roundups show users shopping for better memory and fewer filters.

branding.domain_note: Uses getswerve.com with a get prefix; contact is founders@getswerve.com.
branding.brand_signature: AI fiction that unfolds around what you say and do
branding.community_and_virality: Secondary review sites report over 500,000 community-created characters; this comes from a single review source and is not verified.

brand_strength.rationale: Short evocative name, but it collides with other companies called Swerve (a self-driving firm and another YC startup) and no brand press was found.

pivots.from: AI character chat and branching stories app
pivots.to: app for making AI videos with friends
pivots.why: Not stated; the YC page shows both descriptions and the order is unclear.

outcome_analysis: Swerve is a two person team from Winter 2025 with robotics-industry backgrounds that built a consumer AI fiction app. No funding, outcome event or verified traction was found. The category is crowded and easy to copy, so the outlook is unproven and no factors are assigned.
notes: Company website fetch was blocked by a rate-limited domain safety check, not worked around. Competitors come from 2025 roundup articles with no exact dates. The pivot entry is uncertain: YC describes both a character chat app and an AI video-with-friends app, and sources do not order them. A different YC company also named Swerve (AI browser agents, W25) exists; do not confuse.
